## Components this documentation uses

The site is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) on the
[zotqda-quarto-theme](https://github.com/fre-ms/zotqda-quarto-theme) (MIT), with
[Noto Sans](https://fonts.google.com/noto) under the SIL Open Font License.

The plugin itself has **no runtime dependencies**. It renders PDF pages with the
[pdf.js](https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/) build that Zotero already ships
(Apache-2.0) rather than bundling one.
